rules.title: Santa Ana ban on algorithmic rent-pricing devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not sell, license or use algorithmic devices to set rental prices. Violations can be fined $1,000, enforced mainly through code enforcement.
rules.key_value: ban on sale, licensing and use of algorithmic rent-pricing devices; $1,000 fine
rules.quoted_span: prohibiting the sale, licensing and use of Algorithmic Devices
rules.effective_date_note: Article says first vote Feb. 17 and a later Tuesday final vote put it into effect; exact year and effective date not stated. Ordinance number not stated in the article (taken from the challenge context).

parsed.doc_summary: News article on Santa Ana's ordinance banning landlords' use of algorithmic rent-pricing software, with a $1,000 fine. It gives no ordinance number or effective date.
